import_approvals.rationale: C17.01 approves exactly PMF.productChannel, productChannel_apply, mem_support_productChannel_iff, productChannel_map_eval and productChannel_map_restrict. Each reuses finiteProduct and its existing laws; inputs require no Fintype or distribution. Separate index/input/output/restriction universes, zero masses, dependent fibers and empty/vacuous cases are retained. No new simp, helper API or semantic dependency. C17.02 adds exactly finiteProduct_bind_productChannel, channelComp_productChannel and productChannel_deterministicChannel. Finite dependent sum/product interchange proves independent processing; row specialization proves composition without finite original inputs; finiteProduct_pure proves deterministic reduction. No new imports, public helpers, representation or simp attribute. C17.03 adds only memorylessChannel as the thin identical-channel specialization. Finite block transports remain private consumers of existing C16 equivalences and generic channel laws. No new imports, simp rules or public block aliases. C17.04 adds exactly channelJoint_productChannel_map_eval, channelJoint_productChannel_map_restrict and finiteProduct_channelJoint_map. Map/bind algebra transports arbitrary-input coordinate/block joints without finite-input or independence premises; the independent-input law uses the existing dependent tuple/pair equivalence. Only the latter requires finite inputs. No extra output alias, semantic producer, import or simp rule.
